editorial.blurb: A bustling noodle house in Chinatown where hand-pulled noodles and generously portioned soups arrive with impressive speed and flavor.
editorial.insiderTip: Go right when they open on a Sunday for shorter waits, and order the chow hand-pulled noodles with pork belly — the chili oil and pickled mustard greens on the table let you customize heat to your liking.
signatureDishes: Chow hand pulled noodles with pork belly
